title: Jab Khuda ko Pukaara Ali Aagae
body:
MOMINOO KO MUBAREK ALI A.S AAGAYEE
Jab Ali agaye zindagi agai., Zindagi bandagi roshni agai., Roshni agai aagahi agai., 1.Maut inke muhibbo ko
<<DIVIDER>>
aati nahi., Aa bhi jaaye to phir
Bach ke jaati nahi. ×2
<<DIVIDER>>
Maut ka kya Qatar
maut se kya hai darrr., Isse bachna bhi kya
<<DIVIDER>>
agai agai., 2.ghusl e mayyat na khna
mere ghusl ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Ujle malboos ko mat
kafan naam do ×2
<<DIVIDER>>
Mai chala hoo ali se
mulaqaat ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Jiski thi arzoo wo ghadi
aagayi
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Teri massnad pe
ghairo ko bithladiya., Nayib e mustafa
<<DIVIDER>>
mazhar e kibriya., Tu Ali o vasi o wali Hi
raha., Mannzilat me teri kya
<<DIVIDER>>
kami agai., 4.ham ke sarr shaar ishq
aur tawalla me thay., Jaante Hi na thay nafrat
<<DIVIDER>>
o dushmani., x2
Ye tawalla bhi wallah
<<DIVIDER>>
kya cheez agai., Humko aghyaar se
dushmani agai., 5.Masslak e ishq me
<<DIVIDER>>
maangna ayb hai., Main bhi khamosh hu
Vo bhi khamosh hai., x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Unko sab hai khabar
islye chup hu main., Kya hua aankh me garr
<<DIVIDER>>
nami agai., 6.jis ka moula tha mai
uss k moula ali.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab nabi ne kaha deen
kaamil howa
<<DIVIDER>>
Marhaba mustafa rab bhi razi howa
Wo jo aana thi aayat
<<DIVIDER>>
wahi aagayee
7.jibraeel aur khamber pe
<<DIVIDER>>
kya munhasir
Dar tera chordh kar koi
<<DIVIDER>>
jaataa nahi
Jo ghulami ka teri maza
<<DIVIDER>>
paa gayaa
Raaz jis ko teri nokri
<<DIVIDER>>
aagayee
8.Khums dena mawadat
<<DIVIDER>>
ki ek shart hai., Aur na dena bhi misl e
fidak hai gunaah., Haq e saadat o Zehra ke maqrooz se., Jab tabarra suna to
<<DIVIDER>>
hasi agai., 9.Ishq jabb takk na ho
Sher hota nahi., Mujhme kab ahliyat thi
<<DIVIDER>>
teri madha ki
Mere moula main
<<DIVIDER>>
qurbaa'n tere ishq ke., Sibt e jafar ko bhi
shayari aagai...
author: Sibte Jaffer Shaheed
